get_split_algo: get a sentence splitter function for a given language code and algorithm name
split_chinese: split Chinese text into sentences using regex-based punctuation detection
split_geez: split Amharic and Tigrinya text into sentences using Ge'ez script rules
split_burmese: split Burmese and Shan text into sentences using regex-based punctuation detection
make_splitter_caseless: wrap a sentence splitter to handle caseless languages like Georgian
